title: 第15章 对对笔迹就知道了
slug: 学霸女神超给力全本免费-学霸女神超给力最新章节列表
content_zh:
“我看云画是真的痴心妄想，已经走火入魔了。”
“不过她看起来，倒真的不像是会勾~引贺御翔。她又那么胆小，更不敢约贺御翔了。”凌潇潇拉着韩露露低声说着。
韩露露也轻轻地点了一下头。
凌潇潇迟疑了一下，又说道：“露露，我看昨天晚上你和贺御翔的事情，只怕是有人故意设计的。不然怎么会那么巧？对了，你怎么会跟贺御翔约在小桃林呢？”
韩露露咬牙：“因为……我收到了贺御翔的纸条。”
“纸条？贺御翔给你写的纸条，上面约你去小桃林？”凌潇潇又问。
“嗯。”
韩露露抿起了唇，眼神陡然凌厉起来：“贺御翔说他根本没写过纸条给我。”
“那只要查出来纸条到底是谁写的，不就知道了？”凌潇潇连忙说道。
韩露露咬牙切齿，“要是被我知道的谁，哼，我非扒了她的皮！”
凌潇潇笑了笑，“反正我觉得不太可能是云画，就她对齐学长那痴心妄想的样子，啧啧，已经走火入魔了。还有啊，我也从来不觉得贺御翔喜欢云画啊，贺御翔喜欢的一直都是温温柔柔很优雅的女生，比如你。云画到底是从农村来的，长得漂亮又如何，一身土气，就是乡下土妞，贺御翔怎么可能喜欢她。”
贺御翔喜欢温温柔柔很优雅的女生？
韩露露的脑海中顿时就出现了一个人，萧如月，可不就是温柔优雅大方么。
而且，贺御翔在她面前的时候也夸赞过萧如月很多次……
“萧萧，你去……帮我把萧如月的作文本找来，或者是笔记本也行。”韩露露眯着眼睛说道。
凌潇潇愣了一下，“露露，你怀疑那个纸条是萧如月写的？是萧如月故意设计你和贺御翔的？”
“是不是，等对对笔迹就知道了！”
云画唇边挂着浅浅的笑容，回到了教室。
她的位置在最后一排，因为没人愿意跟她坐。
才刚坐下，坐在第三排正中间“黄金位置”的萧如月就走了过来，亲昵地跟她挤在一张椅子上。

“画画，你怎么现在才来？我以为你早到了呢。”萧如月温柔地笑着。
云画哼了一声：“韩露露也不知道怎么回事，我刚进学校就被她给堵住了，非要问我昨天晚上去哪儿，还要搜我的手机，我说手机丢了她还不相信。”
萧如月的笑容微微一僵，然后立刻说道，“你别惹韩露露，她爸可是教导主任，咱们班主任也是她小姨，你要是惹了她……”
“我没惹她！”云画咬着唇很是生气，“我没事儿惹她干什么啊，可是她污蔑我，说我勾*引贺御翔！真是有病，我又不喜欢贺御翔，我勾*引他干嘛，神经病啊！”
萧如月眨了一下眼睛，“啊？”
云画哼了一声，忽然又笑着抱住了萧如月的胳膊，“月月，你是我最好最好的朋友，我喜欢谁，你知道的吧？”
萧如月的笑容有些僵硬，“当然啊，你喜欢的是齐学长嘛，学校里有几个女生不喜欢齐学长，正常啦。”
云画却眨了眨眼睛，故意用一种娇羞的语气说道：“月月，我有个好消息，再不跟你说，我都就要憋死了！”

content_en:
"I think Yun Hua is really delusional and has gone crazy."
"But she really doesn't look like she can seduce He Yuxiang. She is so timid, and she doesn't dare to ask out He Yuxiang." Ling Xiaoxiao pulled Han Lulu and whispered.
Han Lulu also nodded slightly.
Ling Xiaoxiao hesitated for a moment and then said: "Lulu, I think what happened between you and He Yuxiang last night was deliberately planned by someone. Otherwise, how could it be such a coincidence? By the way, how could you have an appointment with He Yuxiang in Xiao Taolin?"
Han Lulu gritted her teeth: "Because... I received a note from He Yuxiang."
"A note? A note written by He Yuxiang asking you to go to Xiao Taolin?" Ling Xiaoxiao asked again.
"Yeah."
Han Lulu pursed her lips and her eyes suddenly became sharp: "He Yuxiang said he never wrote me a note at all."
"Then as long as we find out who wrote the note, we'll know, right?" Ling Xiaoxiao said quickly.
Han Lulu gritted her teeth, "If I find out about anyone, huh, I'll have to skin her!"
Ling Xiaoxiao smiled and said, "Anyway, I think it's unlikely that it's Yun Hua. Just the way she looks at senior Qi with her wishful thinking, tsk tsk, she's gone crazy. Also, I never thought that He Yuxiang liked Yun Hua. He Yuxiang has always liked girls who are gentle, gentle and elegant, such as you. After all, Yun Hua is from the countryside. She is pretty and looks like a country girl. How can He Yuxiang like her? "
He Yuxiang likes gentle, gentle and elegant girls?
A person immediately appeared in Han Lulu's mind, Xiao Ruyue, wasn't she gentle, elegant and generous?
Moreover, He Yuxiang also praised Xiao Ruyue many times in front of her...
"Xiao Xiao, go... help me find Xiao Ruyue's composition copy, or a notebook." Han Lulu said with squinted eyes.
Ling Xiaoxiao was stunned for a moment, "Lulu, do you suspect that the note was written by Xiao Ruyue? Did Xiao Ruyue deliberately set up you and He Yuxiang?"
"Isn't that right? We'll know after we check the handwriting!"
Yun Hua returned to the classroom with a slight smile on his lips.
Her seat was in the last row because no one wanted to sit with her.
As soon as she sat down, Xiao Ruyue, who was sitting in the "prime position" in the middle of the third row, came over and squeezed into the same chair with her intimately.
"Huahua, why are you here now? I thought you had arrived early." Xiao Ruyue smiled softly.
Yun Hua snorted: "Han Lulu doesn't know what's going on. She blocked me as soon as I entered the school. She insisted on asking me where I went last night and searched my cell phone. She didn't believe me when I said I lost my cell phone."
Xiao Ruyue's smile froze slightly, and then she immediately said, "Don't mess with Han Lulu, her dad is the dean of students, and our class teacher is also her aunt. If you mess with her..."
"I didn't mess with her!" Yun Hua bit his lip and got very angry, "Why did I mess with her when I had nothing to do, but she slandered me and said I seduced He Yuxiang! She is really sick, and I don't like He Yuxiang. Why did I seduce him? I'm crazy!"
Xiao Ruyue blinked, "Huh?"
Yun Hua snorted, then suddenly smiled and hugged Xiao Ruyue's arm, "Yueyue, you are my best best friend. You know who I like, right?"
Xiao Ruyue's smile was a little stiff, "Of course, you like Senior Qi. There are a few girls in the school who don't like Senior Qi. That's normal."
But Yun Hua blinked and deliberately said in a shy tone: "Yueyue, I have good news. If I don't tell you, I will choke to death!"
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
